content: Review the repository specifications against the project's own stated aspirations, identify design contradictions, and remove them through record-level amendments without implementing product functionality.

D0008: the vroot synthetic NVIDIA identity is recorded as a presentation disguise governed by M0003-W04. It must deterministically pre-bind only metaflux_pci, is never eligible for vendor-driver matching, and never implements vendor-private RM/UVM behavior. M0003 decision 4 now requires registration and legal review before any release promotion. Amended: kernel/vroot/README.md, agent/memory/project.md, agent/plan/M0003-vpci-lifecycle/plan.md, agent/memory/decisions-index.md.

D0009: the userspace glibc floor is closed at 2.31 with Ubuntu 20.04 as the floor distribution. Provider DT_NEEDED is restricted to libc.so.6 plus libpthread.so.0 and libdl.so.2 only where a pre-2.34 target requires them; the kernel validation matrix stays independent. M0001 decision 1 keeps only the release distribution matrix open. Amended: agent/memory/constraints.md, agent/plan/M0001-core-foundation/plan.md, agent/memory/decisions-index.md, tests/CMakeLists.txt comment.

The v0.1 memfd transport gets an explicit wake contract: cold operations may syscall freely, one active-queue dispatch may perform at most one wake syscall, worker spin/sleep policy is worker-side implementation freedom, and the zero-syscall steady-state obligation begins with the M0002 doorbell transports (cdev, vfio-user BAR2). Amended: docs/architecture/control-and-data-plane.md, agent/plan/M0001-core-foundation/plan.md, transports/memfd/README.md.

Numeric performance budgets now carry a front-matter budgets status of provisional or binding. A budget is provisional until the measurement harness it names exists and a baseline is archived; provisional budgets guide design but do not fail acceptance. M0001 is marked provisional pending the M0001-W01 reference-host harness. Amended: agent/templates/milestone.md, agent/README.md, agent/plan/M0001-core-foundation/plan.md.

The authoritative logical-device view is scoped per managed domain; cross-vendor coexistence uses explicit loader namespaces (M0001-W06) rather than merged enumeration. Amended: agent/memory/project.md.
